title: lantana camara subsp. moritziana
intro: Lantana camara subsp. moritziana, commonly known as Yellow Button Lantana, is a shrub-like plant in the Verbenaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to protect against infections and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Button Lantana include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Lantana camara subsp. moritziana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
